how.title: How It Works
how.step1_body: Choose date, time, and duration. Instant confirmation.
how.step1_modal_body: Book entirely online in three steps. Choose your date, time, and duration — confirmation is instant, no waiting for a human reply. Pay with Apple Pay, Visa, Mastercard, or UnionPay.
how.step2_body: Get your QR code instantly. Scan at the door. Auto-unlock.
how.step2_modal_body: Once confirmed, you receive a unique QR code valid for your session window. Scan the door lock on arrival — it unlocks automatically. No staff needed at any point.
how.step3_body: HK$1 = 1 point. The more you play, the more you save.
how.step3_modal_body: Earn 1 point for every HK$1 spent and level up automatically. Three tiers — Nova, Platinum, Diamond — each unlocking exclusive benefits.

how_to_book.question: How do I book a table?
how_to_book.answer: Click "Book Now" on the homepage, select date, time and table, then complete payment.

cancel_booking.question: Can I cancel a booking?
cancel_booking.answer: Confirmed bookings cannot be cancelled or refunded. For special circumstances, please contact customer service.

earn_points.question: How do I earn points?
earn_points.answer: After each booking, you automatically earn points based on spending and tier. Higher tiers earn more points.

redeem_points.question: How do I use points?
redeem_points.answer: Points can be redeemed for offers in the Points Shop. Offers can be used during booking for discounts.

tier_upgrade.question: How do I upgrade my tier?
tier_upgrade.answer: Tiers are automatically upgraded based on lifetime points. Tiers never downgrade, only upgrade.

payment_methods.question: What payment methods are accepted?
payment_methods.answer: We accept credit cards, FPS, Alipay and WeChat Pay.

birthday_perk.question: How do I use the birthday perk?
birthday_perk.answer: Set your birth month in Settings (cannot be changed once set), then enjoy double points during your birthday month each year.

change_password.question: How do I change my password?
change_password.answer: Go to Settings > Security and click "Change Password". We'll send a secure link to your email.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.faq_booking_q: How do I book a table?
faq.faq_booking_a: Select a date, time slot, and duration, then pay instantly with Apple Pay or a credit card. You'll receive a QR code immediately. No staff assistance required.
faq.faq_entry_q: How do I enter after booking?
faq.faq_entry_a: After payment, you'll receive a unique QR code. Scan the door sensor on arrival and the system unlocks automatically — fully self-service.
faq.faq_cancel_q: Can I cancel or get a refund?
faq.faq_cancel_a: Once confirmed, bookings cannot be cancelled, rescheduled, or refunded (except under Typhoon Signal No. 8 or above / Black Rainstorm Warning, when a reschedule may be requested). For full details, see the Venue Rules and Terms, [Section 3](/legal?doc=terms#section-3) and [Section 6](/legal?doc=terms#section-6).
faq.faq_hours_a: SPACE8 is open daily from 06:00 to 24:00, year-round, including public holidays.
faq.faq_smoking_q: Is smoking prohibited inside the room?
faq.faq_smoking_a: The entire venue is strictly smoke-free (including cigarettes, e-cigarettes, and heated tobacco) to maintain the highest-quality smoke-free environment. If you need to smoke, please use the building's outdoor smoking area.
faq.faq_weather_a:
[Typhoon Signal No. 8 or above / Black Rainstorm Warning]
Open as usual: The venue's automated systems keep running, so you may come as planned once you've judged it safe to do so.
Reschedule policy: If you decide not to come, you must contact us via WhatsApp before your original booking start time to arrange a free reschedule within 7 days (no refund).
Late requests: Requesting after the booking time has passed, or not using it within 7 days, is treated as forfeiting the entitlement.

[General conditions / other weather (e.g. Signal No. 3, Red Rainstorm)]
No cancellation or change: Apart from the extreme-weather policy above, all confirmed bookings cannot be cancelled, rescheduled, or refunded.
faq.faq_overtime_q: What if I run over time?
faq.faq_overtime_a: If no other guests are booked after your slot, please leave within 15 minutes (if you keep using the facilities beyond 15 minutes' overtime, a full 1-hour rental charge applies). If the next slot is already booked, the system sends a friendly reminder on the concierge screen 5 minutes before your slot ends — please tidy up and leave before your booking time is over.
faq.faq_pricing_a: Rates are charged per hour and vary by time slot, with discounts for booking 2 or more consecutive hours; overtime stays incur an additional overtime charge. For full details, see the [Pricing page](/pricing) and the Venue Rules and Terms, [Section 3](/legal?doc=terms#section-3).
faq.faq_points_q: How does the points system work?
faq.faq_points_a: Earn 1 point per HK$1 spent. Accumulated points upgrade you to Platinum and Diamond tiers with extra privileges. For full details, see the [Membership page](/membership).
faq.faq_facilities_a: Professional pool tables, high-quality standard house cues, premium lighting, air conditioning, free Wi-Fi, and a self-serve water station.
faq.faq_guests_a: Yes, each session can accommodate multiple players. The session fee covers everyone — no extra charge per person.
faq.faq_contact_a: Reach us via WhatsApp or email hello@space8.com.hk — we'll get back to you promptly.

pilot_features.body: Scan in and the screen greets you by name, tier, and total wins, drawing from 450 welcome lines that shift with the time of day. Every visit feels fresh.

pilot_features.title: Let the AI run your tournament
pilot_features.body: Not sure how to organise a big group? The system recommends the fairest format that actually fits your session, and starts it in one tap.

pilot_features.title: Five formats to choose from
pilot_features.body: Round robin, Swiss, double elimination, king of the table, and single elimination — the right fit for anything from three friends to a group of eight.

pilot_features.title: Wins that stack up
pilot_features.body: Every result feeds your personal total, taking you from Nova to Platinum to Diamond. Now there's something to play for.

pilot_features.title: Friends without memberships? No problem
pilot_features.body: Add a guest player in one tap and they're in the match instantly. They can always join up later to keep their record.

pilot_features.title: Big-screen live scoring
pilot_features.body: Red versus blue, bold and clear, readable from anywhere in the room.

pilot_features.title: Time management without the awkwardness
pilot_features.body: Automatic alerts at 10 and 5 minutes, a polite wrap-up message, and renewal by QR code. No staff involvement needed at any point.

pilot_features.title: Do Not Disturb mode
pilot_features.body: While you're focused on the table, the screen simply tells the time. It only speaks up in the last five minutes.

pilot_features.title: Trilingual interface
pilot_features.body: Instant switching between Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, and English for regulars and visitors alike.

pilot_features.title: Two rooms, one experience
pilot_features.body: Space Infinity and Space Eternity, both running the same seamless system.
